claim_scope: Consumed development mechanism qualification only; no effectiveness, generalization, or SOTA estimate.
prior_result: V1 was stopped after 69 ordinary shell calls and one operation-tool call; its dual-tool interface was rejected while the incremental-program hypothesis remained untested.
hypothesis: A single familiar arbitrary-Bash action channel with an explicit inspect-versus-persist annotation makes operation-linked program construction natural enough to test the incremental-program hypothesis.
case_selection: Reuse the exact three V1 consumed cases and order. No case is added or removed after observing V1 or V2 outcomes.

method.only_change_from_v1: Replace separate envbench_shell and apply_environment_step actions with one envbench_shell requiring effect=inspect or effect=persist.
mechanisms: successful persistent commands appended verbatim to one ordered program
complete public-goal observation after every appended command
automatic target-state replay on construction-goal Pass
excluded: stronger prompt patches to the rejected V1 interface

qualification_observations: inspect, persist, and invalid annotation counts
first persist request and successful recorded steps
human-audited required deployment mutations declared inspect
first sufficient state to replay delay in model requests
ordered replay outcomes and same-session repairs
exact accumulated program delivered after replay Pass
requests, tokens, wall time, network traffic, and storage

decision_policy.interface_qualified: Real deployment mutations use effect=persist without a second action tool, successful persistent commands are recorded exactly, and every observed sufficient state after a recorded command triggers replay in the same tool turn.
decision_policy.interface_rejected: Required deployment mutations continue through effect=inspect, successful persist commands are not recorded exactly, or a sufficient state fails to trigger replay.
decision_policy.effect_claim: No effect claim is permitted from these outcome-conditioned cases regardless of Official results.
decision_policy.promotion_claim: Mechanism activation can reject this version but cannot promote it without a later fixed outcome-blind comparison.

execution.provider: OpenRouter fixed DeepInfra route without fallback
